_network_type: Nested leave-one-speaker-out (LOSO/LOGO) architecture search: NSGA-II runs SEPARATELY for each of 4 model families (SNN-AE, LSTM-AE, GRU-AE, Transformer-AE), one OS process per (dataset, outer fold). Goal (2026-09-22 scope change): find the best autoencoder overall across all 4 families at equal latent_dim=32, not 'SNN vs 3 fixed baselines' -- every family now searches its own architecture and its own input encoding.
_architecture_summary: SNN-AE: free encoder_widths genome (strictly decreasing, decoder mirrors encoder), exponential surrogate; R, C, V_th learnable, clamped 1e-6. LSTM-AE/GRU-AE: hidden_size + num_layers genes (Meeting01RecurrentGaGenome). Transformer-AE: d_model + n_heads + n_layers + d_ff genes, d_model % n_heads == 0 enforced by repair (Meeting01TransformerGaGenome). All 4: encoding (direct/poisson/latency) is a gene, latent_dim is fixed at 32 (never a gene) so every family is compared at the same compression ratio. Each family's driver runs its own NSGA-II (population x (1+generations) evaluations), selects the winning genome from its own rank-0 Pareto front on the inner validation speaker, retrains it on train+val (early-stopping on a recording-disjoint monitor carved from train), evaluates once on the held-out test speaker, then the 4 winners are compared (val_mse, then inference cost) and the overall winner is recorded in a '_run<r>_overall_winner_manifest.json'.
_preprocessing: Non-overlapping 256-sample windows (32 ms @ 8 kHz for FSDD / AudioMNIST; 360 Hz for MIT-BIH). Per-window z-score, then spike encoding over model.time_steps = 16 REAL simulation steps -> a (16, 256) time-major tensor (row = t*B + b). Encoding (direct/poisson/latency) is a GA gene for every family, not an outer sweep. Every model -- SNN and the three baselines alike -- is trained to reconstruct the ORIGINAL z-scored window (repeated across the 16 steps), never its own spike code, so val_mse is comparable across encodings and families. Stratified per-fold window caps (loso_max_{train,val,test}_windows = 200 / 150 / 1500) round-robin across recording_id so every speaker/recording stays represented; LOSO structure and the recording-level statistical unit are unchanged.
_total_runs_breakdown: Per (dataset, fold, run_id): 4 SEPARATE NSGA-II searches (SNN + LSTM + GRU + Transformer), each population x (1 + generations) evaluations + |Pareto front| x (winner_seeds - 1) re-scorings + 1 retrained winner. SNN's budget (population 8 x (1+5 generations) = 48 evaluations) was measured against real per-epoch cost at these production settings (200 train windows, T=16). ga.lstm/ga.gru/ga.transformer below are NOT YET calibrated the same way -- they are unset here and fall back to Meeting01Config's struct defaults (population 10 x (1+8) = 90 evaluations each), which is a placeholder, not a measured equal-time budget. Per the approved multi-family plan, population_size/generations for these 3 must be set from a real per-epoch cost probe at T=16/200 windows before this profile is grid-ready -- until then this profile's LSTM/GRU/Transformer arms cost roughly 90/48 =~ 1.9x the SNN arm each, not the equal-wall-clock budget the design calls for. Overall: swapping 3 fixed-architecture baselines for 3 more GA searches of comparable size to the SNN's roughly QUADRUPLES total grid wall-clock time versus the SNN-only design. x 3 datasets x 6 folds x 5 seeds. Weeks on CPU.
_dataset_config: Speaker/record-disjoint outer folds (6). No pooled sample caps (max_loaded_train_samples / max_validation_samples = 0 -> every window of the disjoint partitions, then the stratified loso_max_* caps apply). 30 epochs max, early stop patience 5, lr 0.001 (weights) / 0.0001 (R, C, V_th), batch size 1. Per-epoch progress on stderr as '[loso] ... epoch N/M' (survives nohup, where the live bars collapse).
_comment: Nested-LOSO multi-family architecture search for the meeting01 paper revision. NOT YET GRID-READY: see _total_runs_breakdown -- ga.lstm/ga.gru/ga.transformer budgets are placeholders pending an empirical per-epoch cost measurement. Run once via scripts/pipeline/meeting01/01_meeting01_run_loso.sh (ONE invocation; ~weeks). cv_fold here is a default; the run script overrides it per process with --cv-fold.
